title: Choose the visual world for MKDynamics
question: The roll assigned the Ligne Claire Album. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Ligne Claire Album
options.lineage: Belgian ligne claire comics (Brussels school: Hergé, Swarte, Ever Meulen posters)
options.thesis: A Belgian IT partner told the Belgian way: one uniform ink line, flat colour, nothing shaded, nothing hidden. Refuses the navy-gradient hero over a stock photo.
options.viewport: An album page: a wide first panel carries the headline in lettered caps over a flat blue field, a tall photo panel framed in ink, a yellow '50+ projects' panel, and a red caption box as the 'Talk to us' action.
options.risk: Could read playful for a security firm if the lettering or grid loosens; the strict panel grid and restrained captions carry the seriousness.

raised.raise: Solid black is reserved for the decisive beat: the contact panel alone goes black and breaks the gutter.
Total ink commitment: four flat inks plus paper, no tints, no gradients, no shadows anywhere.
Each panel owns exactly one truth: one service, one claim, one action per panel.
Annotations pinned to their subject on ink leader lines instead of floating labels.

options.label: Metro Line Diagram
options.thesis: Design, development and security as stations on one line: one partner, one ride.
options.viewport: One horizontal line crossing the screen with the five services as stations, the headline set as a platform sign.
options.risk: Transit-map metaphors are familiar in agency sites; clear but less memorable.

options.label: Exposure Record Sheets
options.case: Fuses poorly: an operator's tool, SME owners do not identify with it.
options.kept: A strict tonal token set: the palette is the only colour vocabulary.

options.label: Night Instrument Six-Pack
options.case: Fuses weakly: implies live monitoring MKDynamics does not sell.

options.label: Tensegrity Column
options.case: Fuses poorly: abstract, hides what the company does.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud Edge
options.case: Fuses poorly: soft, no link to IT or security.
options.kept: Colour confined, text field stays achromatic.

options.label: Risograph Zine Cover
options.case: Fuses for designers only; loses SMEs and security trust.

options.label: Manga Screentone Page
options.case: Close cousin of the roll, but Belgian visitors read BD, not manga.
options.kept: Solid black reserved for the decisive beat.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The IT-agency site every competitor ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Big headline, photo, service cards, CTA, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
